[SWS_CM_10342] Source of a SOME/IP response message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007,
RS_SOMEIP_00009, RS_SOMEIP_00010

set according to [SWS_CM_10310].

shall be set according to [SWS_CM_10311].
